results.title: The Hunt for the Last Nazis
results.original_title: The Hunt for the Last Nazis
results.overview: With exclusive access to never-seen-before classified government files and explosive video and audio recordings, this is the scandalous story of how thousands of alleged Nazi war criminals hid in Australia after WWII and managed to evade justice – despite a government-sanctioned Special Investigations Unit desperate to prosecute them.

results.title: Sugod
results.overview: After a violent encounter with the police during a rally, a young boy is offered possible release by his detainees at great personal cost.

results.title: Anchors Aweigh
results.overview: When a well-meaning loser gets rejected by his much younger and more successful blonde girlfriend, he rents a small sailboat by the airport and spirals into a state of deep personal reflection.

results.title: We Only Want the Earth
results.overview: An iconic presence in the landscape of Irish socialism and republicanism, the name of James Connolly looms large in the trade union movement, and wherever radical left-wing politics are espoused. This film tries to bring Connolly’s many achievements in the field of workers’ and women’s rights into the fore, alongside his role in the 1916 Easter uprising.

results.title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
results.original_title: 死亡遊戯で飯を食う。 44:CLOUDY BEACH
results.overview: Overcoming the jinx known as the "Thirty Game Wall," which drastically reduces the survival rate of players, Yuuki continues her journey. A game where death is always close at hand. Next, she takes on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. Eight players have gathered there. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows. The game is "Cloudy Beach." Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she makes a living playing deadly games.

results.title: The Trial
results.overview: Three brothers face a ruthless gangland trial after their heist goes disastrously wrong.

results.title: Dick Up My Sleeve
results.overview: Detective Dick Pounder investigates a group of missing boys, uncovering a  shadowy conspiracy of magic and misdirection.

results.title: Do It Live
results.overview: A newscaster has a mental breakdown behind the scenes.

results.title: Silent Mode
results.overview: A singular night out leads best friends Andrei and Lucho to an unexpected liberation.

results.title: The Lion at My Back
results.overview: Mariama, an asylum-seeker from Senegal, has just turned 18. Stella, at first glance a withdrawn woman in her 40s, has recently decided to break free from the clutches of addiction and to give her life a fresh start. In their attempt at finding their place in a world where nothing comes for free, the two women meet and form an unexpectedly strong bond.

results.title: TJPW Home Cheer Home ~Mifu Ashida's Homecoming Show~
results.original_title: TJPW HOME CHEER HOME～芦田美歩地元凱旋興行～
results.overview: TJPW Home Cheer Home ~Mifu Ashida's Homecoming Show~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW). It was held on April 4, 2026 at Fukuchiyama Sandan-ike Park Gymnasium in Fukuchiyama, Kyōto, Japan.

results.title: Phenomena
results.overview: A psychedelic odyssey into the fabric of the universe, guided by a filmmaker’s immersive practical experiments that transcend into a deeply hypnotic audio-visual experience of awe and human connection to the natural world.

results.title: Stereolab: Live in Concert at First Avenue in Minneapolis, October 11, 2025
results.original_title: Stereolab: Live in Concert at First Avenue in Minneapolis, October 11, 2025
results.overview: Stereolab’s most recent album is 2025’s Instant Holograms on Metal Film. Five months after that album’s release, Stereolab found themselves at the storied Minneapolis music venue First Avenue, where they performed to a sold-out room filled with enthusiastic fans.  Stereolab treated the energetic crowd to a rich array of songs from the new album, as well as several selections from their back catalogue, including one from their second EP, Super-Electric, released in 1991.

results.title: Waltz for Maria Domingas
results.overview: On the industrial outskirts of São Paulo’s ABC region, Maria Domingas, an exhausted factory worker, breaks away from her routine for the first time: instead of going straight home, she stops at a bar. There, under the weight of the silence and oppression of her time, an encounter opens a mysterious window to tenderness and humanity in her life.

results.title: Joelma - Isso É Calypso Tour Brazil: Live in Brasília
results.original_title: Joelma - Isso É Calypso Tour Brasil: Ao Vivo em Brasília
results.overview: The project Joelma - Isso é Calypso Tour Brasil: Ao Vivo em Brasília was a DVD recorded at Granja do Torto on October 18, 2025. The high-level recording featured a 58-meter stage and guest appearances by Wanderley Andrade and Vingadores do Brega, with the audiovisual release scheduled for March 2026.
